description: Index two workspace states and answer "what breaks if we ship head?": symbols that are removed or no longer exported while other files still referenced them (with importer citations), files that lost their last inbound edge, and node/edge counts. Each side is a git revision (branch, tag, SHA — verified, no shell) or a directory path.

base.description: Base side: git rev (e.g. "main") or a directory path.

head.description: Head side: git rev (e.g. "HEAD" or a PR SHA) or a directory path.

limit.description: Cap per list (default 50; counts stay exact).

name: graph_diff
title: Diff two revisions
